main_measure.name: pooled mean of (forecast/10) x (r2 - m2) on Sunday-close active bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2.0 and supporting check > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2.0; at least 300 Sunday cases

supporting_check.name: mean of -sign(weekend move) x (r2 - m2), top half of |forecast| minus bottom half

decided_by: t >= 2.0 but the supporting check is at or below 0 (or not computable), which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Cases are bars starting on Sunday (UTC) with non-zero forecast and close[t+2] in the same window; m2 is each coin's mean 2-bar return on the grid 0,2,4,... of every window pooled over windows; the median split puts |forecast| above the median in the larger half and the rest in the smaller half; weekend move sign is the sign of the raw component value.
